latin: Substantiales rerum uisibilium qualitates non a uirtute separata particulari, ut credunt aegyptii, sed a primo receptaculo fontis luminum per animalem splendorem dependenter resultant.
translation: The substantial qualities of visible things do not result, as the Egyptians believe, from a particular separate power, but dependently from the first receptacle of the fount of lights, through an ensouled splendor.
